name: Weichai / Baudouin
legal_name: Weichai Power Co., Ltd. (HKEX 2338, SZSE 000338); Societe Internationale des Moteurs Baudouin (Cassis, France), wholly owned by Weichai since 2009
hq: Weichai Power: Weifang, Shandong, China. Baudouin: Technoparc du Bregadan, 13260 Cassis (Marseille), France
founded_note: Weichai Power incorporated 23 December 2002 (parent Shandong Heavy Industry Group; Weichai diesel plant roots in 1940s Weifang). Baudouin acquired 2009 (DCD states US$3.8 million).
employees: 101,440 at 31 December 2025 (including 42,175 at KION), Weichai Power 2025 annual results
revenue: RMB 231,809 million (2025, up 7.47 percent); net profit attributable RMB 10,931 million (2025, down 4.15 percent); H1 2026 revenue RMB 123.16 billion (up 8.8 percent), net profit RMB 7.7 billion (up 36.5 percent). Overseas over 50 percent of revenue (2025).
sector: Diesel and gas engines, high horsepower PowerKit genset engines (M26, M33, M55, M61) and complete data centre generator sets 1,900 to 6,250 kVA; SOFC
positioning_text: Weichai is the Chinese OEM with the fastest growing large genset engine business: 2025 data centre backup power sales rose 259 percent, M-series large-bore engines passed 10,000 units, and H1 2026 data centre genset sales (over 1,400 units) already beat full-year 2025. Baudouin is the French brand it uses for the Gulf, selling PowerKit engines to local packagers (Almajd Power in Jeddah, Galadari Energy Solutions in Dubai) and, since October 2024, complete data centre gensets from 2,000 to 6,250 kVA with Uptime Institute pre-approved ratings, 50 degree C cooling packages and a marketing pitch built on lead time rather than brand. Baudouin has been a platinum sponsor at Middle East Energy in Dubai (seventh participation in 2025), exhibits at Data Center Nation Riyadh, and its M55 engines now also arrive in the region inside Generac's 2.25 to 3.25 MW data centre sets. Weichai Middle East FZE operates from Jebel Ali as a power generator supplier.

movements.headline: Baudouin launches complete generator sets for data centres, 2,000 to 5,250 kVA (baseline)
movements.summary: Baudouin moved from engines only to complete M33 and M55 gensets for data centres with Uptime Institute pre-approved units and announced the 20M55 genset (4,250 to 5,250 kVA). Manufacturing sites listed in India, China, Russia, Italy, Germany, France and the US.

relevance.analysis: This is the structural change: Baudouin now bids as a single-brand genset supplier, not just an engine to local packagers, and it targets the same hyperscale and colocation buyers Cummins Arabia courts in Riyadh, Dammam, Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Cummins Arabia should expect Baudouin gensets in consultant shortlists from 2025 onward.

movements.headline: Baudouin exhibits at Data Center Nation Riyadh with 2,000 to 5,250 kVA M33 and M55 gensets
movements.summary: Baudouin presented its data centre genset range and previewed the 20M55 to Saudi operators and developers, citing Uptime Institute pre-approval and ISO 8528 G3 load acceptance.

relevance.analysis: Direct marketing into the Saudi data centre pipeline. Cummins Arabia should make sure Saudi data centre consultants and EPCs have Cummins DCC ratings, 60 Hz performance data and local service commitments in hand before Baudouin's lead-time pitch lands.

movements.headline: Baudouin platinum sponsor at Middle East Energy 2025: 20M61 genset (6,250 kVA) pre-launch, 6M31 Stage V PowerKit, 20M55 gas genset
movements.summary: At Dubai World Trade Centre (stand S3.B40 and outdoor OS.90), Baudouin revealed the 20M61 data centre genset up to 6,250 kVA, launched the 6M31 Stage V-ready PowerKit and showed a 20M55 gas genset up to 5,250 kVA, 12M33 plus SCR Stage V and 6M16 Stage V. CEO Fabrizio Mozzi called it the largest genset available for critical backup power. Baudouin claimed best lead times in the market.

relevance.analysis: A 6,250 kVA single unit outranks Cummins' largest diesel node and is aimed at hyperscale campuses in the UAE and KSA. Cummins Arabia's counter is the installed base, Cummins factory paralleling and controls, service depth and proven 50 degree C performance. It should also test Baudouin's lead-time claims against real Cummins slot availability when quoting.

movements.headline: Baudouin publishes November 2025 data centre genset rating cards (50 and 60 Hz) covering WPG1900 to WPG5775
movements.summary: The 50 Hz card runs from WPG1900 (16M33G1900, 1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5775 (20M61G5940, 5,250 kVA DCP at 11 kV); the 60 Hz card runs from WPG1540B76 (1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5000B76 (20M61G5000, 6,250 kVA DCR at 13.8 kV). EPA Tier 2 genset models are available.

relevance.analysis: The 60 Hz card matters for Saudi Arabia: Baudouin now publishes DCR and DCP ratings at 1800 rpm including 13.8 kV medium voltage sets, which is what Saudi data centre specifications ask for. Cummins Arabia should benchmark its 60 Hz C2500 to C3500 DCC offers against the WPG2500B76 to WPG4000B76 band.

movements.headline: Weichai 2025 results: data centre backup power sales up 259 percent, M-series engines pass 10,000 units, 20M61 5 MW engine launched
movements.summary: Weichai Power reported 2025 revenue of RMB 231.8 billion. Data centre backup power product sales rose 259 percent; M-series large-bore engine sales exceeded 10,000 units (up 32 percent) with revenue up 65 percent. It launched the 20M61, described as the world's first 5 MW high-speed diesel generator engine, and PSI (US) derived 81 percent of revenue from power generation.

relevance.analysis: Weichai now has the volume and cash flow to price aggressively in export markets and to fund Baudouin's Gulf marketing. Growth of this scale in one year also means Weichai capacity is real, which supports the lead-time argument used against Cummins in Gulf tenders.

movements.headline: Baudouin positions 1,900 to 6,250 kVA range for hyperscale campuses and pushes lead time as the decisive variable

relevance.analysis: This is the sales script Cummins Arabia will meet in Gulf data centre bids: a bigger single unit and a shorter delivery slot. Cummins Arabia needs firm factory slot commitments in its proposals and should quantify Cummins' service network and parts stock in KSA and UAE against Baudouin's thin local footprint.

movements.headline: Baudouin partners with EODev on solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) power, commercial launch September 2026
movements.summary: EODev will roll out Baudouin SOFC continuous baseload power across Europe with exclusive rights in France and Poland. Weichai's SOFC system holds EU CE certification with over 65 percent electrical efficiency and Weichai deepened its Ceres Power collaboration in November 2025.

relevance.analysis: Europe only for now, but SOFC baseload for data centres is the kind of grid-independent offer Gulf hyperscalers will ask about as grid connection queues lengthen. Cummins Arabia should track whether Baudouin brings SOFC to Middle East Energy 2027.

movements.headline: Weichai H1 2026: data centre genset sales above 1,400 units, more than all of 2025
movements.summary: Weichai reported H1 2026 revenue of RMB 123.16 billion (up 8.8 percent) and net profit of RMB 7.7 billion (up 36.5 percent). Data centre generator sales exceeded 1,400 units in the half, surpassing full-year 2025, with M-series high-power engines at 6,700 units (up 31.5 percent). Baudouin signed a strategic cooperation with a major French customer.

relevance.analysis: Run-rate of roughly 2,800 data centre gensets a year puts Weichai among the largest volume producers of data centre sets worldwide. Gulf hyperscalers that buy globally will see Weichai and Baudouin on approved vendor lists, which erodes the reference advantage Cummins holds in the region.

movements.headline: Generac's Baudouin M55 based 2.25 to 3.25 MW data centre sets gain a global hyperscale supply agreement covering the Middle East
movements.summary: Generac's SDMD2250, SDMD2500 (12M55, 65.6 L) and SDMD3250 (16M55, 87.5 L) diesel sets use Baudouin M55 engines with Marathon DataMAX alternators and DSE G8601 controls. Generac signed a global supply agreement with a hyperscale operator naming APAC, Europe, Middle East and Latin America.

relevance.analysis: Baudouin engines reach the Gulf through two brands at once: Baudouin's own WPG sets and Generac's SDMD sets. In a hyperscale programme awarded globally, Cummins Arabia can lose Saudi or UAE sites without ever seeing a local tender. It should work with Cummins Inc. on global account coverage rather than rely on local bids alone.

movements.headline: Baudouin joins the Gulf Data Centre Association (GCDA) alongside Italian and Spanish data centre associations (baseline)
movements.summary: Baudouin announced collaborations with GCDA (covering Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and UAE), IDA (Italy) and SPAIN DC, promoting M Series engines 25 to 4,150 kVA with cooling above 50 degree C ambient and HVO testing.

relevance.analysis: GCDA membership gives Baudouin a seat in the Gulf data centre community and its events. Cummins Arabia should confirm its own visibility in GCDA programmes so Baudouin does not become the default OEM voice there.

movements.date_note: Context entry; no dated Gulf event found
movements.headline: Yuchai (China Yuchai International, Singapore HQ, NYSE CYD) is the second Chinese engine OEM whose genset engines appear in low-cost Gulf packages
movements.summary: China Yuchai International, through Guangxi Yuchai Machinery, produces engines for generator sets alongside marine and industrial engines. No verified 2025 to 2026 Gulf distributor announcement, Gulf project or data centre product from Yuchai was found in this research.

relevance.analysis: Yuchai-powered sets from Chinese packagers compete at the low end of Gulf tenders (typically below 1,000 kVA). Cummins Arabia's exposure is in price-led utility, telecom and construction bids in KSA and Kuwait rather than in data centres. Track Chinese packager registrations on Etimad and CAPT rather than Yuchai itself.
